title: Kisan-e-Mitra helps farmers get answers about their government benefits
description: Kisan e-Mitra helps farmers get answers about India's PM-KISAN benefits. They can check payment details and whether they are registered to receive support. Wadhwani AI contributed to its development alongside other partners. The system offers voice and text assistance in 11 languages and is available around the clock through the scheme's website and mobile app. In March 2026, India's agriculture ministry reported that it had answered more than 9.5 million questions from over 5.3 million farmers.
